outgoing.name: Japan
outgoing.excerpt: The Green Pheasant of Japan is very similar to Common Pheasant, but the males have greenish plumage.

outgoing.name: North America
outgoing.excerpt: Pheasants were introduced in North America in 1913, being released at Dog Ear Butte.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Pheasant farms have some 10 million birds in the U.S. and 35 million in the United Kingdom.
